note.ja: 解析解 無次元x∈[0,1]、同次Dirichlet、κ=.1、θ=.2、T=.1。内点7/15、時間step64/128/256。目的関数はh重み付き終端誤差と指定二次正則化です。 固定stepの離散随伴でありCVODESや最適checkpoint法ではありません。40nは状態・随伴・RHS/solve scratchの一意な所有要素数です。静的因子・model配列は別表示し総所有byteへ含めます。検証/NPZ組立は測定後で、RSSではありません。
note.en: Analytic reference Dimensionless x in [0,1] with zero Dirichlet data, kappa = .1, theta = .2 and T = .1. Use 7/15 interior nodes and 64/128/256 time steps. The objective has an h-weighted terminal error and specified quadratic penalties. Fixed-step discrete adjoints, not CVODES or an optimal checkpoint schedule. The40n limit counts unique evolving state/adjoint/RHS/solve-scratch elements. Static factors/model arrays are separately listed and included in total bytes. Validation/NPZ assembly follows the ownership windows; this is not RSS.
